puzzles.title: The Rune-Carved Watchtower Archway
puzzles.prompt: Three weathered words are chiseled across the lintel above a sealed recess: "I have no voice yet guide ships through fog; feed me a spark and darkness flees, drown me in water and I sleep. What am I?"
puzzles.hint: Think of what sits atop the southern cliff waiting for a spark.
puzzles.failureText: The runes flicker dimly and remain shut. Consider what guides sailors through sea fog and try again.

transcript.speaker: Rune Archway
transcript.text: The lintel glows warm emerald-gold and slides open, revealing the Watchtower Bronze Crest!
